notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch (curl_cffi via probe.fetch) returned HTTP 200 for every /collections/<handle> page - no block. r.jina.ai is now Cloudflare-403 from this box (as the prior Home-Decor note warned), so it was not used. robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent. TREE: two independent nav sources were merged. (1) The desktop mega-menu, which ships fully in the static HTML of any PLP (ul.main-menu). (2) A richer <script type="application/json"> nav blob embedded in every collection page (menu -> children -> grandchildren) that drives the mobile menu; it adds three real furniture nodes the desktop menu omits: Swivel Chairs & Recliners, Accent Tables and Wall Units. Breadcrumbs on each PLP were used to confirm parentage. QTY: Arhaus is Shopify with a Bloomreach-rendered grid - the static HTML ships an empty grid, so counts come from the Bloomreach endpoint core.dxpapi.com/api/v1/core/ (account_id=7981, domain_key=arhaus_us, request_type=search, search_type=category, q=<collection handle>) response.numFound, which is exactly the field the PLP's own 'N Items' header renders. That equivalence was proven live in Chrome on three pages of different sizes: Sofas '141 Items' = numFound 141, Chairs '222 Items' = numFound 222, Cabinets & Storage '9 Items' = numFound 9. Every count was read twice with zero drift, and independently cross-checked against paged /collections/<handle>/products.json enumeration (sofas 141/141, dining-chairs 79/79, beds 95/95, desks 34/34, file-cabinets 3/3, wall-units 2/2, bar-storage 29/29, cabinets-storage 9/9; chairs 223 vs 222 and outdoor-chairs 58 vs 57 differ by one unpublished/unindexed item - the rendered header matched Bloomreach, not products.json). Counts discriminate properly (no constant site-wide number) and every PLP h1/breadcrumb matched the handle requested. SUBSET CARE (per the prior pass's warning): full pid sets were pulled for all candidates and cross-intersected. Three containments are flagged rather than silently dropped: Accent Tables (74) is entirely inside End Tables (133); Swivel Chairs & Recliners (134) is entirely inside Chairs (222) + Outdoor Chairs (57); the bath Cabinets & Storage overlaps Cabinets by 7/9. Partial overlaps (Buffets & Sideboards/Media Consoles 34, Ottomans & Benches/Poufs 21, Entryway/Console Tables 23) are flagged too. All eleven outdoor sub-categories are mutually disjoint. DEDUPED: /collections/benches-daybeds is linked as both 'Daybeds & Settees' (Living) and 'Benches & Daybeds' (Bedroom) - emitted once. /collections/bookcases-and-shelving is linked from both Living and Office - emitted once. NOT EXTRACTED - PLP merchandising carousels, not nav nodes: every leaf PLP carries a 'related collections' slider whose targets are attribute/style cross-cuts that are 100% subsets of the parent and appear in neither nav source. Verified and skipped: chaise-sectionals(36)/reclining-sectionals(40)/corner-sectionals(44)/curved-sectionals(16) all 100% inside Sectional Sofas; leather-sofas(35)/daybeds(10) 100% inside Sofas, reclining-sofas(32) 81%, settees(13) 85%, sleeper-sofas-and-chairs(18) 61%; swivel-chairs(80)/recliners(32) 100% inside Chairs; rectangle/round/square coffee tables; rectangle/round/oval/extension dining tables; upholstered-beds(56)/canopy-poster-beds(9)/extended-beds(15)/shelter-beds(30) all 100% inside Beds; console-tables-sideboards and benches-settees off the Entryway page; outdoor-coffee-and-accent-tables off the Outdoor page. EXCLUDED per scope: Mattresses & Box Springs (bedding, not furniture); all Bedding, Tabletop, Lighting, Art & Mirrors (incl. Bath Mirrors), Rugs, Decor (pillows, throws, vases, candleholders, candles, botanicals, games, jewelry), Storage & Organization (trays/boxes/baskets/hooks - standalone storage goods, a future Storage task), Bath Hardware (hooks, towel bars, faucets, bath accessories); Outdoor Decor (fire pits, planters, umbrellas, garden decor, outdoor pillows/poufs, beach towels, outdoor rugs); Outdoor Care Products and Outdoor Covers, Touch Up Kits, Seating Cleaning Kits, Finish Boards and swatches (furniture care/parts). Also dropped as navigation junk: all New Arrivals and Sale nodes, Shop All / Shop the Collection tiles, /pages/ inspirational galleries and collection landing pages, and /collections/sectional-builder (a configurator page - h1 'CREATE YOUR ARHAUS SECTIONAL', no product grid at all).
